exclusionSection.title: Keep-out zones
exclusionSection.drawHint: Use the no-entry tool on the map to draw keep-outs.
exclusionSection.selfIntersectHint: This keep-out outline crosses itself — the enforced no-fly area is smaller than drawn. Delete it and redraw.
exclusionSection.conflictHint: Move the dock, shrink the orbit, or replan. Upload is not blocked.

planningSidebar.dragToMove: Drag to move, double-click to remove
planningSidebar.clickMapToSetStart: Click map to set start point
planningSidebar.fenceObservedHint: Read from the connected UAVs, not from the plan.
planningSidebar.fenceHint: Auto-generated from the search zone, corridor, fallback delivery locations, and simulation docks. Drag the amber handles on the map to reshape it; double-click a handle to delete it.
planningSidebar.fenceRequestNone: Next upload: no fence change — the vehicles keep their current settings.
planningSidebar.fenceRequestEnable: Next upload: requests this fence update with the mission
planningSidebar.fenceRequestDisable: Next upload: requests fence disable with the mission
planningSidebar.fenceRequestInvalid: Fence enabled but its shape is unusable — nothing will be sent until it is fixed.
planningSidebar.fenceUploadHelp: Uploading without a fence edit preserves the vehicles' settings. Changing the planner fence requests an update. Switching it Off requests a disable on the next upload.
planningSidebar.clickTrackWps: Click track waypoints on the map to select simulation docks
planningSidebar.fenceSelfIntersect: The fence outline crosses itself. The vehicle treats the crossed-over pockets as OUTSIDE the fence — untangle the shape or reset to auto.
planningSidebar.fenceSlidersPaused: Sliders resume after Reset to auto — the fence shape is operator-edited
planningSidebar.fenceCoverageWarning: The edited fence no longer covers the full flight path (zone, takeoff round, corridor, or confirmation orbits). UAVs outside the fence will RTL — enlarge the fence or reset to auto.

calibrationTab.title: Radio Calibration
calibrationTab.noVehicles: No connected UAV. Connect a vehicle to calibrate its radio.
calibrationTab.waitingRc: Waiting for RC input… make sure the transmitter is switched on.
calibrationTab.armedWarning: Vehicle is ARMED. Disarm it before calibrating the radio.
calibrationTab.instructions: Move all sticks and switches to their full extremes, then capture the center.

status.partial: Some parameters failed to write. Check the vehicle link and retry.
status.noChannels: No channels moved — sweep all sticks and switches to their extremes first.
status.error: Save failed — no response from backend.

calibration.title: Compass Calibration
calibration.description: Calibrate a UAV's compass before flight. Rotate the vehicle through all orientations while calibration runs. After it succeeds, accept the result and reboot the autopilot.
calibration.startingHint: Starting calibration — rotate the vehicle through all axes…
calibration.rebootRequired: Reboot required for the new compass offsets to take effect.
calibration.rebootConfirmMessage: This will reboot the flight controller. Do this only on the ground, before flight.
calibration.intro: Calibrate accelerometers before flight. Keep the vehicle still on a level surface unless a prompt says otherwise.
calibration.levelDesc: Sets board-level trim from the current resting attitude. Place the vehicle level first.
calibration.fullDesc: Interactive 6-position accelerometer calibration. Follow the prompts and confirm each position.

connectionTab.title: Connection
connectionTab.autoConnectHelp: In sim mode, discover and connect vehicles automatically when the app starts.
connectionTab.sitlHelp: Each row maps to a vehicle sys_id (ID 1, ID 2, ...). Used by per-UAV "Start NavPy Sim" buttons.
connectionTab.diagnosticsHelp: Export a bounded session timeline for support. It excludes coordinates, parameter values, connection addresses, and continuous telemetry.

flightTab.title: Speed & Range
flightTab.takeoffAltitudeInfo: Climb-out height that ends the takeoff phase. The aircraft continues climbing to mission altitude on the first leg. Capped at the first-leg altitude.

visionProfile.title: Vision Profile
visionProfile.overlapHint: FOV-edge overlap between cameras: positive = views intersect, negative = gap. Uses each camera's zoom.
visionProfile.scanPitchHint: Camera pitch: steeper = higher altitude, shallower = more forward reach

note.failClosed: Cannot optimize: camera calibration missing or pitch too shallow.
note.gimbalPitch: Altitude capped by the gimbal pitch limit.
note.minAltFloor: Altitude held at the minimum-altitude floor.
note.recognitionCap: Altitude capped to keep the dock confirmable at max zoom.
note.ceiling: Altitude capped by the max-altitude ceiling.

fallbackDeliveryLocationsTab.title: Fallback Delivery Locations
fallbackDeliveryLocationsTab.name: Name
fallbackDeliveryLocationsTab.description: Preconfigured delivery locations used as a fallback when no suitable destination is found in the search zone.
fallbackDeliveryLocationsTab.noLocations: No fallback delivery locations defined. Add manually or import a CSV file.

launchTab.autoPreflightCalInfo: When on, START runs gyro + baro/ground-pressure calibration on disarmed vehicles before arming.
launchTab.autoPreflightCalHint: Runs on disarmed vehicles only; skipped if armed. Default off.
launchTab.preflightCalSettleInfo: Wait after calibration so the gyro cal finishes before arming.
launchTab.containerDesc: Container mode: uses ESP32 relay triggers for physical launch
launchTab.bungeeDesc: Bungee mode: ARM + AUTO per vehicle (no ESP32 hardware)
launchTab.simulatorHelp: Runs a local ESP32 simulator so you can test the full container launch flow without hardware.
launchTab.channelHelp: Map each vehicle to an ESP32 relay channel (1-6)
launchTab.sequenceHelp: Use the arrows to set the launch order; pick each vehicle's ESP32 channel (container).
launchTab.tuningActiveNote: Advanced launch tuning is active (non-default values). Enable DEV mode to view or edit it.
launchTab.tuningAirborneHelp: How a vehicle is judged airborne after the launch trigger. Climb confirmation is off when rate is 0.
launchTab.tuningReadinessHelp: Per-check launch gates (launch only; restart keeps fixed defaults). GPS fix threshold is fixed at 3.
launchTab.blockUnknownBatteryHint: Block launch when battery telemetry is missing
launchTab.hostInfo: IP address or hostname of the ESP32 launch controller.
launchTab.portInfo: HTTP port the ESP32 launch controller listens on (default 80).
launchTab.altitudeThresholdInfo: Relative altitude (m) above which a vehicle is considered airborne after the launch trigger.
launchTab.armTimeoutInfo: How long to wait for arm confirmation before failing the vehicle (container).
launchTab.altitudeTimeoutInfo: How long to wait to reach airborne altitude after the launch trigger before failing.
launchTab.containerSettleInfo: Pause between switching to AUTO and sending ARM, container path. Default 0.3s.
launchTab.containerStaggerInfo: Delay between UAVs within a container. 0 = back-to-back.
launchTab.containerGapInfo: Extra delay inserted between containers (each holds 3 UAVs). 0 = no gap.
launchTab.bungeeSettleInfo: Pause between switching to AUTO and sending ARM, bungee path. Default 0 (none).
launchTab.bungeeArmTimeoutInfo: How long to wait for arm confirmation before proceeding, bungee path. Default 5s.
launchTab.bungeeStaggerInfo: Minimum delay between consecutive bungee launches. 0 = back-to-back.
launchTab.requireArmedInfo: Require the vehicle to be armed (not just above altitude) before marking it airborne.
launchTab.requireThrottleInfo: Also require the autopilot to be commanding throttle (motor driven) before marking airborne — confirms powered flight, not just altitude.
launchTab.minThrottlePctInfo: Minimum commanded throttle output (VFR_HUD, 0-100%) required when 'Require throttle commanded' is on.
launchTab.minClimbRateInfo: Minimum sustained climb rate (m/s) required to confirm airborne. 0 disables climb confirmation.
launchTab.climbConfirmInfo: How long the climb rate must stay above the minimum before confirming airborne. 0 disables it.
launchTab.checkPrearmInfo: Block launch when the vehicle's pre-arm check is failing or not yet reported.
launchTab.checkGpsInfo: Block launch without a GPS 3D fix. The fix-type threshold (3) is fixed.
launchTab.checkGpsAccInfo: Block launch when the GPS horizontal accuracy is worse than the limit below.
launchTab.maxGpsHaccInfo: Maximum allowed GPS horizontal accuracy (m) to permit launch. Smaller is stricter. Only applies when 'Check GPS accuracy' is on.
launchTab.checkThrottleInfo: Block launch when the throttle (RC3) is not low.
launchTab.maxThrottleRc3Info: Throttle PWM (RC3) at or below which throttle is considered low. Above this blocks launch.
launchTab.checkBatteryInfo: Block launch when the battery level is below the minimum.
launchTab.minBatteryPctInfo: Minimum battery percentage required to allow launch.
launchTab.blockUnknownBatteryInfo: Block launch when battery telemetry is missing (no battery monitor reporting).

preflight.airspeedConfirmMsg: This also zeros the airspeed sensor. Cover the pitot and make sure the air is calm — calibrating with airflow bakes in a bad offset for the whole flight.

fix.gps: Move to open sky, wait for GPS lock
fix.ekf: Hold still while the EKF settles; re-cal if it persists
fix.rc: Check the transmitter is on and bound
fix.companionChecking: Companion link verifying — usually a brief heartbeat gap
fix.mission: Upload a mission plan before launch
fix.checksDisabled: Arming checks are off — enable when ready
fix.compass: Calibrate the compass (rotate through all axes)
fix.gyro: Calibrate gyros — hold the vehicle still
fix.airspeed: Zero airspeed with the pitot covered
